meta.title: SPP hourly demand, wind and solar, 2025: EIA-adjusted extract, before this course's cleaning
meta.source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-930 Hourly Electric Grid Monitor, six-month BALANCE files (on the Grid Monitor's dashboard: Download Data → Six-Month Files), balancing authority SWPP (Southwest Power Pool), calendar year 2025, 'Adjusted' columns
meta.license: EIA data are U.S. government works in the public domain; this extract CC BY 4.0
meta.units: MW: average power over the hour; times one hour, it is that hour's energy in MWh
meta.time: index i is the hour ENDING at start_utc + i hours, in UTC; local time is U.S. Central (America/Chicago), with daylight saving
meta.columns: demand: Demand (MW) (Adjusted); wind and solar: sum of the adjusted net-generation columns for that fuel, negatives set to 0
meta.not_cleaned: Extraction only: each fuel's adjusted generation columns are summed and negative values set to 0; no hour is repaired. The cleaned shapes in town_year.json are prepared for this course from these values (EIA-930, the same two files and access date).

dataset.creator: Honglin Li
dataset.status: Real data, an EIA-adjusted extract of SPP's 2025 hourly values: each fuel's columns summed and negative generation set to 0; before this course's anomaly repairs, so no hour is repaired.
dataset.source: Extracted from EIA's Form EIA-930 six-month BALANCE files for 2025 (file names and SHA-256 checksums in meta).
dataset.license: This extract: CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), Honglin Li. The underlying EIA-930 data are U.S. government works in the public domain.
